units.source_text: 回到家后，出乎意料的是，父亲的病情跟上次回来时差不多，没有多大变化。

en.t: After I returned home, I was surprised to find that my father's condition was much the same as when I had last come back, with no great change.

units.source_text: 能顺顺当当毕业，比什么都好。

en.t: The best thing of all is that you were able to graduate without any trouble.

units.source_text: 你等一下，我去洗把脸就来。”

en.t: Wait a moment; I will go wash my face and be right back.

units.source_text: 当时，父亲正在院里干着什么活计。

en.t: At the time, Father was out in the yard doing some kind of work.

units.source_text: 父亲说完，就去了有水井的后院。他头上戴着顶旧草帽，系在草帽后面的脏兮兮的遮阳手帕随风飘动着。

en.t: After saying this, Father went to the back yard where the well was. He was wearing an old straw hat, and the dirty sunshade handkerchief tied to the back of it fluttered in the wind.

units.source_text: 我把大学毕业看成理所当然的事，见父亲竟高兴成这样，不禁有些困窘。

en.t: I had taken graduating from university as a matter of course, so seeing Father so unexpectedly delighted made me feel somewhat embarrassed.

units.source_text: “你小子能顺顺当当毕业，真好啊。”

en.t: It really is good that you managed to graduate without any trouble.

units.source_text: 这句话父亲翻来覆去念叨了好几遍。

en.t: Father repeated those words over and over again.

units.source_text: 我暗自将父亲欣喜的表情和毕业那晚在先生家吃饭时，先生说“祝贺你”时的神情作了比较。

en.t: Inwardly, I compared Father's delighted expression with Sensei's face when he had said, Congratulations, at dinner at his house on the night of the graduation ceremony.

units.source_text: 在我看来，嘴上说祝贺，心里却嗤之以鼻的先生，反而比少见多怪、喜形于色的父亲更显得高尚。

en.t: To me, Sensei, who offered congratulations with his mouth while secretly looking down on it, seemed more refined than Father, who made too much of it and showed his joy so openly.

units.source_text: 我对父亲这种愚昧无知的乡土气感觉不快起来。

en.t: I began to feel displeased by this ignorant, provincial quality in Father.

units.source_text: “就算大学毕了业，也没什么了不起的呀，每年的毕业生有好几百人哪。”

en.t: Even graduating from university is nothing so remarkable; several hundred people graduate every year.

units.source_text: 我终于说出了这样刻薄的话。

en.t: At last I said something so harsh.

units.source_text: 听了我的话，父亲露出怪异的表情，说：“我不光是说你毕了业有多么好。

en.t: Hearing my words, Father made a strange face and said, I am not only saying how good it is that you graduated.

units.source_text: 能毕业固然好，可我的话里还有另一层意思呢。

en.t: Of course graduating is a good thing, but there is another meaning in what I am saying.

units.source_text: 你要是能够明白我的意思……”

en.t: If only you could understand what I mean...
